routes.title: Funding arbitrage scanner (all coins)
routes.description: Funding arbitrage scanner across 8 exchanges (Bybit, Hyperliquid, dYdX, Gate, Kraken, Bitfinex, Deribit, OKX): for every coin the widest cross-venue perp funding spread, the long and short venue, both funding rates, gross and fee-adjusted net APR and breakeven days, with a 24h volume liquidity filter. Funding rate arbitrage, basis trade and carry screening of perpetual swaps. Data only, no advice. Bad input is free; under 3 venues not charged.

min_apr.description: Minimum gross spread, in APR percent (0-10000). Default 10.

min_volume_usd.description: Liquidity filter: both legs need at least this 24 h volume in USD (0-1e12). Venues that publish no volume are excluded when > 0. Default 0.

fee_pct.description: Taker fee per fill in percent of notional (0-1); 4 fills per round trip. Default 0.05.

holding_days.description: Days the position is held, to amortise the fees in net_apr_pct (1-365). Default 30.
